reason: I'm not handing an unknown Hyderabad startup read access to our Microsoft 365 tenant and ERP full of student data on the strength of a DPDP clause. At most I'd take a free pilot to committee, and that takes months. A paid contract this month isn't happening.
objection: Who are these people, and will they still be around next year? If they leak student data or fold halfway through the year, I'm the one answering to the registrar and the parents. And ₹9 lakh a year for what is really a notification feed on top of Teams and our LMS is hard to defend in committee.
would_change_my_mind: A read-only, least-privilege M365 integration with an independent security audit (ISO 27001 or a VAPT report), plus two or three comparable private universities already running it who I can call.
